id: title:VojtechBartos:render unsaved edits in insight link unfurl charts

review.posthog_relevance: Slack App chart unfurling and query preservation
review.reason: Adds a new optional field chart_edited_query to the _UnfurlCard class to hold unsaved query edits, updates insight card creation to extract an edited query from the URL and populate chart_edited_query, and changes SlackUnfurlChartRequest construction to use the edited query if present, otherwise fall back to the saved insight ID.
review.uncertainty: This score relies on the supplied observations; no independent verification of actual Slack App adoption, downstream chart rendering, or user benefit is available. The tier is assigned based on the implementation and relevant checks being visible, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary/generated-only hunks. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional field chart_edited_query to the _UnfurlCard class to hold unsaved query edits.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Slack unfurl card to carry unsaved query edits alongside the saved insight ID, distinguishing between a saved insight and an edited query state.

observations.behavior: Updates the insight card creation to extract an edited query from the URL, compare it with the saved insight query, and populate chart_edited_query with the edited query or None.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves unsaved query edits in the Slack unfurl card while retaining the saved insight ID, enabling the downstream chart request to use the edited query instead of the saved one.

observations.behavior: Changes the SlackUnfurlChartRequest construction to use the edited query if present, otherwise fall back to the saved insight ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Passes the edited query to the chart request, allowing the chart to render the user's unsaved edits rather than the saved insight query.
